title: BMO launches AI agent to help credit card customers get answers
summary: BMO is introducing AI Agent Assist to help clients get faster answers and resolutions when they contact BMO's Virtual Connect contact centre about their credit card transactions.

title: Wealthsimple unveils Penny AI assistant at 'Wealthsimple Presents'
summary: Penny can prepare e-transfers, pay invoices, flag duplicate credit card charges and help self-directed investors buy and sell. It never acts without client confirmation. ChatGPT and Claude connections are planned for early 2027, along with a rebuilt native mobile app.

title: Wealthsimple Pay: instant transfers up to $100,000 between clients
summary: Available now, Wealthsimple Pay lets clients send up to $100,000 instantly to other Wealthsimple clients. Temporary virtual cards with custom expiry dates and spending limits were also announced.

title: Wealthsimple launches commission-free options on Canadian stocks; Wealthsimple Pro due late November
summary: Wealthsimple says it is the first Canadian brokerage with commission-free options on Canadian stocks. The Wealthsimple Pro trading platform, with Level 2 data, launches in late November 2026.

title: Chime Q3 2026: Jade AI agent, Chime Invest, joint accounts and credit line in beta
summary: On its Q3 call Chime said its Jade personal finance AI agent is available to millions of members. Over recent months it launched Chime Invest, rolled out Visa Flex and introduced joint accounts. An unsecured line of credit is in beta and an unsecured credit card is expected next year.

title: OnePay Taps Stripe to Power Stablecoin Deposits
summary: Digital bank OnePay announced this month that it is allowing select US customers to fund their OnePay checking accounts using stablecoins and receive the value as US dollars, all without requiring a separate crypto account or wallet. title: RBC overhauls Cash Back Mastercard portfolio with $1 redemption minimum
summary: New earn structures took effect automatically on Oct 1, 2026. From December 2026, cardholders can redeem cash back anytime in RBC Online Banking or the RBC Mobile app once their balance reaches $1, and rewards accumulate indefinitely.

title: TD app feature makes it easier to move money from another financial institution to TD
summary: TD launched a new app feature to simplify and speed up moving money from another financial institution into a TD account. This is a headline from TD's newsroom index, so the link goes to the news listing and not the individual release.

title: TD Canada Trust raises TD Prime Rate by 25 bps to 4.70%
summary: TD Canada Trust increased its Prime Rate by 25 basis points to 4.70%, effective October 29, 2026. This affects variable-rate lending products.

title: Scotia app adds credit card self-serve options and scheduled/recurring Interac e-Transfers
summary: The Scotia app now offers expanded self-serve options for credit cards, including setting or updating a PIN and replacing damaged cards. Clients can also schedule future-dated and recurring Interac e-Transfers. The release follows the bank's inaugural Client Innovation Day.

title: Simplii Financial launches new Simplii Account and pilots account folders
summary: Simplii introduced a new account type, the Simplii Account, and is piloting self-built account folders and a payment backup feature that covers certain transactions to reduce insufficient-funds fees. It also partnered with CIBC Investor's Edge so clients can invest while accessing funds from their Simplii account.

title: RBC Mobile adds TipRanks Smart Score research for Direct Investing clients
summary: Version 6.68.1 gives Direct Investing clients access to TipRanks Smart Score research with analyst consensus and price targets.
source: Apple App Store (RBC Mobile release notes)

title: TD expands agentic AI across mortgage operations
summary: TD announced two new agentic AI capabilities for Real Estate Secured Lending, covering mortgage funding and discharge, to speed up the mortgage lifecycle.

title: Scotia Wealth Management launches Scotia Global Intelligence for UHNW clients
summary: A new service gives ultra-high-net-worth clients a comprehensive view of their entire portfolio, delivered by the Chief Investment Office team.

title: Simplii Financial: 4.50% HISA promo for 5 months
summary: Simplii offered 4.50% on a high-interest savings account for 5 months (Oct 1 – Jan 31, 2026). Window has closed — included as an example of own-brand tracking.

title: Canada's Big Six banks explore a shared CAD tokenized-deposit system
summary: RBC, TD, BMO, CIBC, Scotiabank and National Bank are jointly studying a Canadian-dollar tokenized-deposit solution, starting with transfers between institutions. Money would be issued by the commercial banks, not a central-bank digital currency. Described as exploratory.

title: Nubank launches US operations via Lead Bank partnership
summary: Nubank opened US operations at an event at Nu Stadium in Miami, ahead of final charter approval, using partner bank Lead Bank. It also introduced the Nu Global multi-currency account.

title: Nubank US debut offers 3.5% APY savings, 1.5% cashback card and no-fee transfers to Brazil/Mexico
summary: The US launch includes a 3.5% APY deposit account, a no-annual-fee credit card with unlimited 1.5% cashback, and no-fee transfers to Brazil and Mexico.

title: Scotiabank: up to 5% savings promo and bundle worth up to $1,000
summary: A Scotia High Interest Savings promo of up to 5% for 3 months, with a Preferred Package + savings + credit card bundle worth up to $1,000. Promo window referenced as ending Oct 29, 2026 — verify current terms.

title: Open banking framework arriving in Canada in 2026
summary: Canada's federal open-banking framework is slated to begin in 2026, enabling consented read-only data sharing and mandating participation from major banks. Verify specifics against the official regulator page.
